links.comparator_used: Single combined prompt that generates the note and applies privacy requirements in one step
links.outcome: Leakage of third-party personal information in LLM-generated clinical notes
links.effect: Decomposing generation and privacy editing into separate steps could further reduce leakage, but only when privacy was defined with contextual specificity; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.quote: Decomposing generation and privacy editing into separate steps could further reduce leakage, but only when privacy was defined with contextual specificity.

design_hint: privacy prompt instructions and separate privacy-editing step
